AN ACT relating to gaming; providing immunity from civil liability 
for certain agencies, entities and persons relating to the 
pari-mutuel system of wagering;  and providing other 
matters properly relating thereto. 
Legislative Counsel’s Digest: 
 Existing law requires the Nevada Gaming Commission to administer provisions 1 
governing the issuance of licenses and to perform various acts relating to the 2 
regulation and control of the pari -mutuel system of wagering. (Chapter 464 of 3 
NRS) This bill provides that the State of Nevada, the Nevada Gaming Commission, 4 
the Nevada Gaming Control Board, the Off -Track Pari -Mutuel Wagering 5 
Committee and certain other persons are immune from civil liability for any 6 
decision or action taken in good fait h and without malicious intent in carrying out 7 
the provisions of law relating to the pari-mutuel system of wagering. 8 
 
 
THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF NEVADA, REPRESENTED IN 
SENATE AND ASSEMBLY, DO ENACT AS FOLLOWS: 
 
 Section 1.  Chapter 464 of NRS is hereby amended by adding 1 
thereto a new section to read as follows: 2 
 In addition to any other rights, privileges and  immunities 3 
recognized by law, the State of Nevada, the Nevada Gaming 4 
Commission and any of its members, employees, attorneys and 5 
other personnel, the Nevada Gaming Control Board and any of its 6 
members, employees, attorneys and other personnel , and the Off-7 
Track Pari-Mutuel Wagering Committee appointed pursuant to 8
